playbook.note: The strong majority of existing zh_Hans strings keep the English word (64 kept vs 10 手册); keep 'playbook' for consistency. 手册 appears in a minority of strings.

run.note: Noun: 流程 is the majority rendering (72 vs 37 运行). Verb 'run a playbook' = 运行 playbook. Some strings use 运行 for the noun — treat as legacy inconsistency.

resume a run.note: No established rendering in existing zh_Hans; 恢复 matches 'reopen and continue'.

retrospective.note: Majority (18 vs 5 回顾); a few strings keep English 'Retrospective' — treat as untranslated legacy.

owner.note: One string uses 业主, which is a mistranslation; run owner = 流程所有者.

follower.note: Existing zh_Hans is inconsistent (追随者 once, Follow mistranslated as 跟进/后续行动), while Unfollow = 取消关注 and the core product consistently uses 关注 for follow; 关注者 aligns the whole family.

action.note: Run Actions = 流程动作, Task Actions = 任务动作, Channel Actions = 频道动作.

key metrics.note: 核心指标 appears once; 关键指标 is the majority.

due date.note: Existing mixes 到期日期/到期日/截止日期; 到期 forms are the majority.

timeline.note: Existing usage ties 时间线/时间轴; 时间线 chosen as the modern software convention.

stakeholder.note: 相关者 appears once; 相关方 is the majority.

assignee.note: One string uses 受让人, which is a mistranslation.

filter.note: Majority in this repo (7 vs 1 筛选); the core webapp prefers 筛选 — consider unifying on 筛选 in a future cleanup.

run channel.note: Existing renderings are scattered (运行频道, 流程通道, 流程所在的频道); 流程频道 aligns with run = 流程 and channel = 频道.

condition.note: New feature, no existing rendering; Add condition = 添加条件.

attribute.note: Property Fields = 属性字段; same word as user profile attributes, disambiguate by context.

section.note: New feature, no existing rendering; Section name = 部分名称, Add a section = 添加部分.

run summary.note: Existing mixes 运行摘要 and 流程摘要; 流程摘要 aligns with run = 流程.
